parsed.rationale: Both `StitchableWallpaperView.buildShader` (line 48) and `CompositeWallpaperView.buildShader` (line 69) live in the same `Wallpaper` package under `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Renderers/` and exhibit a Jaccard similarity of 0.875, indicating near-identical implementations. Neither record carries any restraint markers (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false), so the duplication is unintentional.
